text: Entry 1923 removes the BiffState-based folder scan. Current msgAdded snapshots the header and queues it only when its New flag is set. The event schema says notification follows filters and junk classification, while later post-classification filters may still move it again. A folder biff indicator and this message-level event are separate signals; do not reintroduce biff-state scanning as the event source without checking that ordering. This is static source inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: New-mail extension events now start from added headers with the New flag
